# Annals of Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** Ann Finance
- **Publisher:** Springer
- **ISSN:** UNVERIFIED
- **Homepage:** https://link.springer.com/journal/10436
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED (aims: https://link.springer.com/journal/10436/aims-and-scope)

## Scope
Per Springer aims and scope: original finance research and applications to neighbouring fields with a clear link to finance; covers asset pricing, corporate finance, derivatives, financial econometrics, mathematical finance and systemic risk; "Finance Notes" section for short papers (≤10 pages).

## Scope Keywords
financial econometrics, asset pricing, systemic risk, mathematical finance, derivatives

## Article Types Accepted
- Research article
- Finance Note (≤10 pages)
- Special-issue papers

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q3 in Finance — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.343; Finance Q3; Economics, Econometrics and Finance (misc.) Q2 (scimagojr.com source id 80174)
- **Open Access:** Hybrid (Springer); no mandatory APC
- **Field:** Finance

## Special Notes
Review speed (Springer journal page): submission to first decision (median) 6 days (period not stated). AI policy: Springer Nature.
